meta.name: high-output-management
meta.description: Manage for output using Grove's "High Output Management": a manager's output is their organization's output, raised by high-leverage activities. Use when the user mentions "high output management", "managerial leverage", "one-on-ones", "1:1 agenda", "OKRs", "performance review", "task-relevant maturity", "delegation", "meeting overload", "new manager", "how do I run a 1:1", or "just got promoted to manager". Also trigger when structuring a manager's calendar and meeting cadence, designing team metrics, running planning, coaching delegation, or preparing performance reviews. Covers leverage, production principles, meetings as the medium of management, decisions, OKRs, and task-relevant maturity. For intrinsic motivation, see drive-motivation. For a company operating system, see traction-eos.

copy.tagline: 用高杠杆活动提升团队产出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是管理者，想用系统方法提升团队产出。
copy.tagline_en: Boost team output with high-leverage activities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a manager looking to systematically increase your team's output.

howto.what: Claude 会运用安迪·格鲁夫的《高产出管理》原则，帮你优化管理行为：聚焦高杠杆活动、用产出指标而非活动指标衡量团队、设计高效的一对一会议和决策流程、制定OKR，并根据任务相关成熟度调整管理风格。
howto.when: 当你提到“高产出管理”、“管理杠杆”、“一对一会议”、“OKR”、“绩效评估”、“任务相关成熟度”、“授权”、“会议过多”、“新经理”等关键词，或要求安排经理日程、设计团队指标、进行规划、指导授权、准备绩效评估时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个每周管理日程，包含一对一会议和深度工作块。
say.note: Claude 会按高杠杆原则安排固定事件并批量处理中断。

say.text: 如何为我的团队设置一对一的频率和议程？
我的团队应该用哪些指标来衡量产出？
